new_pages.text:
How to connect SE Ranking’s Data API to Make – Knowledge Base Explore SE Ranking Tool Solutions API Articles in this section API credit costs Getting Started with SE Ranking's API SE Ranking API Comparison: Project API vs. Data API How to build automated SEO workflows with SE Ranking MCP and GA4 SE Ranking integration with n8n How to connect SE Ranking’s Data API to Make Set up the SE Ranking Project API on Make The API package is available as a standalone product — no active
          SE Ranking subscription is required. Start with a 14-day trial
          that includes 100,000 free API credits . Paid plans include monthly Data API credits for testing: Core (25,000/month), Growth & Enterprise (100,000/month). Legacy v7 plans: Essential (10,000/month),
          Pro (25,000/month),
          Business & Enterprise (100,000/month). Legacy v1-v6: Essential and Pro plans do not include API access.
          To use the API, please purchase the API add-on. The SE Ranking Data API integration enables you to build powerful no-code automations such as backlink exports, keyword lookups, and domain audits without writing any code. To use the integration, you must have an active SE Ranking account and a valid API key. Getting Access to the Data API Access to the Data API is available during the 14-day SE Ranking trial and is included in the Growth and Enterprise plans, each providing 100,000 Data API credits . Legacy Business plans also include 100,000 credits. The API can be enabled upon request by contacting support via in-app chat or by emailing api@seranking.com . Once enabled, you can generate your API key from the API Dashboard. Please note: For login or access-related issues, contact api@seranking.com . Available Modules SE Ranking’s Make integration includes more than 40 modules grouped across core SEO areas. These modules allow you to automate data retrieval, analysis, and reporting workflows. Module Features Backlinks Search backlinks, domains, and authority Track new and lost links over time Export backlink data via scheduled automations Keyword Research Discover related, long-tail, and question-based keywords Retrieve metrics such as search volume, CPC, and keyword
              difficulty Domain Analysis Access organic and paid traffic data per domain Compare domains, analyze authority, and review ad history Account Check subscription status, validity period, and remaining
              API credits Documentation & Resources For technical specifications, endpoint references, and integration examples, consult the official resources: Step-by-step guide in SE Ranking Documentation Make Documentation SE Ranking Data Integrations
